messages:
maria.g: quick kickoff 1: we need final copy and routing for the webinar + launch posts. goal: drive dev signups that reach first successful query within 48h. smaller seed (500) then scale.
jon_k: concrete hypothesis: surfacing a real-world performance benchmark + ready-made prompt templates increases 7-day activation rate more than just free credits. we should test narrative A: "speed & cost" vs B: "prompt templates + credits".
priya.s: agree. plan to craft two launch post variants and two webinar CTAs. variant A will emphasize median token latency and batch economics. variant B will emphasize "ship an LLM feature in 2 hours" with prompt templates.
ash: engineering ask 1: can we produce a short reproducible bench snippet to embed in the post? small docker command + config so folks can validate. keeps claims trustworthy.
ash: propose snippet:
```bash
# reproduce our bench (toy)
docker run --rm redwood/bench:latest
  --model redwood-2-small
  --seq 512 --batch 8 --quant 4bit
  --requests 1000
```
derek: for the webinar landing: we should split inbound into three cohorts: 50% prompt-template-flow, 30% credit-only, 20% control (no incentive). track via utm_variant and session_id. if prompt-template_flow underperforms at 24h, auto-fallback to credit-only.
kai: analytics notes 1: event names -> webinar_signup, landing_variant, promptpack_imported, credit_redeemed, first_success_query. dashboard funnel metrics: signup -> import -> query -> paid-conversion.
noah: email A/B subject lines brainstorm:
A) "See 50ms median token latency — live demo"
B) "Ship an LLM feature this week with our prompt templates + credits"
C) "Free developer starter kit for webinar attendees"
priya.s: we'll seed a small send to 500 folks to measure open/click; bias B to product-adjacent segments.
maria.g: UTMs i'm proposing:
https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=spark-launch&utm_medium=post&utm_variant=perf
https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=spark-launch&utm_medium=post&utm_variant=templates
https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=spark-launch&utm_medium=post&utm_variant=credits
please confirm variant naming.
jon_k: looks good. ensure the webhook payload includes utm_variant, session_id, and cohort_id. also push a short event when a promptpack is imported.
ash: product work 1: promptpack import should be one-click and include a minimal serverless example for node/python. i estimate 2 dev days. can we scope it down? maybe start with node snippet then add python later.
derek: i'll own the serverless example (node). will mock a tiny lambda that calls the SDK and logs success.
kai: experiment config from growth-bot: 
- cohorts: templates (50%), credits (30%), control (20%)
- primary metric: first_success_query (48h)
- secondary: promptpack_imported (24h), credit_redeemed (24h)
- success threshold: +3% absolute uplift vs control
- alert channel: #marketing
growth-bot: experiment deployed to staging. will flip to prod at 10:00 PT Monday if seed checks pass.
priya.s: followup cadence post-webinar:
- immediate: replay + promptpack + 75 free credits (expire in 14 days)
- day2: quickstart checklist + code GIF
- day5: one-case success story + office hours invite
- day10: conversion nudge + pricing highlight
maria.g: copy guidelines: short bullets, engineer-forward language, single CTA per touch. benchmark callouts must link to the reproducible appendix. add GIF of a one-file example shipping in <2 mins.
jon_k: social copy draft incoming. will include bench stat + 2 CTAs: "Join webinar" and "Try starter kit". planning for a tiny thread on X + a concise LinkedIn post.
noah: routing failover note: if templates cohort shows >10% worse first_success_query at 24h, automatically route remaining signups to credits cohort and notify #marketing. we should flag this as rollback criteria.
priya.s: can we also test office-hours incentive? half of the promptpack cohort gets an invite to an office hours session (to increase engagement). A small factorial.
kai: analytics: factorial increases complexity but we can encode office_hours=true/false in the webhook. dashboard will show breakdown. this is doable.
maria.g: owners recap: content -> priya + jon, engineering -> ash + derek, analytics -> kai, ops -> noah. deliverables by Friday: launch post drafts (A/B), benchmark appendix, UTMs, email copy, webhook schema, promptpack quickstart stub.
derek: i'll post the serverless example PR by Thursday EOD.
jon_k: i'll post the social drafts in #marketing-drafts for reviews.
priya.s: i'll queue seed send and report open/click by EOD tomorrow.
growth-bot: reminder set: run seed send at 09:00 PT tomorrow; monitor opens and clicks; deploy experiment to prod after manual signoff.
maria.g: great work. keep messages tight in reviews. we'll iterate copy tomorrow morning. :rocket:
